remarks: Stylish, Fully Renovated Colonial in Tranquil Country Setting  This beautifully updated 4-bedroom Colonial offers the perfect blend of classic design and modern comfort in a serene, high-end neighborhood. With three finished levels of living space, this home features hardwood floors throughout, a brand-new kitchen with sleek finishes, and fully renovated bathrooms.  The layout is ideal for everyday living and entertaining, with a covered back porch, spacious patio, and a fenced-in backyard complete with a fire pit-great for relaxing evenings or outdoor gatherings.  Enjoy move-in-ready convenience in a peaceful setting, just minutes from town amenities, parks, and local attractions.  Note: Photos are from previous listing.
